research_question: Do provider-native vortex-filament phase dynamics require an effective Sine-Gordon restoring law and/or Mittag-Leffler fractional-memory relaxation after held-out confirmation, numerical certification and evidence-class-aware replication?
objective: Blindly compare preregistered phase and relaxation model families on provider-native dynamic fields while separating implementation controls, simulations and physically independent evidence.
null_hypothesis: H0: Sine-Gordon and Mittag-Leffler descriptions do not achieve the preregistered discovery, held-out, numerical-certification and independent-replication thresholds beyond the registered alternatives.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: one or both candidate mechanisms outperform the registered alternatives, survive held-out and numerical certification, and replicate across eligible independent physical evidence.
assumptions: The provider freezes the phase observable before A056 model scoring; A056 does not infer a favorable phase definition after seeing outcomes.
The time and arclength-like coordinates are monotone and approximately uniform within the registered tolerance.
Python/NumPy FP64 is the reference numerical lane and C++/OpenMP FP64 is the certification lane; SYCL FP32/DD32 remains screening-only.
For conservative inviscid dynamics, a decreasing projected ringdown observable is interpreted as transfer/dephasing unless a separate dissipative mechanism is supplied.

symbols.si_unit: m^2 s^-2 when s is metres

equations.dimensional_check: Both sides have dimensions T^{-2} for dimensionless phase when [a]=L^2 T^{-2}.

equations.purpose: Bayesian information criterion used on discovery blocks
equations.dimensional_check: Model residuals are compared within one observable/scaling; BIC differences are dimensionless.
Numerator and denominator have the same observable units, so NRMSE is dimensionless.
Each exponential argument is dimensionless and w is dimensionless.
Coefficient vectors are compared componentwise under the same coordinate units; ratio is dimensionless.

observables.definition: Provided zero-baseline ringdown observable or preregistered derived POD-energy proxy.
Discovery BIC separation and held-out NRMSE ratio.

steps.operation: Verify frozen protocol/blind commitments and enumerate hashed provider cases.
Validate provider metadata, array shapes, monotonicity, finite values and sampling uniformity.
Evaluate Python FP64 finite differences, POD spectral stability and the Mittag-Leffler alpha=1 exponential identity.
Fit Wave/Klein-Gordon/Duffing/Sine-Gordon and exponential/stretched/bi-exponential/Mittag-Leffler families on discovery blocks and evaluate BIC.
Evaluate frozen held-out temporal blocks with NRMSE ratios.
Apply deterministic coarsening diagnostics and strict C++/OpenMP FP64 parity to confirmed candidates.
Consume optional canonical-framework SYCL/DD32 smoke evidence as screening-only diagnostics.
Assess evidence-class-aware replication; synthetic/simulation controls cannot close physical cross-source replication.
Classify joint, phase-only or memory-only physical support only after eligible replication.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Sine-Gordon fails discovery Delta-BIC >= 10 or the registered held-out NRMSE-ratio threshold.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: No Sine-Gordon phase support for that case.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Mittag-Leffler fails Delta-BIC >= 10, held-out NRMSE ratio, or the support interval 0.48 < alpha < 0.97.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: No fractional-memory support for that case.

falsification_criteria.criterion: A confirmed candidate fails registered resolution convergence or strict Python-FP64/C++-FP64 parity.
Only synthetic/simulation evidence or fewer than two eligible independent physical groups support the candidate.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: Implementation/simulation support only; no physical cross-source claim.

edge_cases: The alpha -> 1 boundary is an ordinary exponential null and cannot count as fractional memory.
A Mittag-Leffler-like tail may approximate a continuum or mixture of ordinary modes; bi-exponential competition and held-out scoring reduce but do not eliminate this identifiability risk.
Closed filament geometry can have frame/gauge ambiguities; phase_definition_id must be frozen upstream.
In inviscid conservative dynamics an apparent ringdown need not imply dissipation.
predictions: If Sine-Gordon closure is physical, positive a and b and held-out superiority should recur across independent provider families.
If effective fractional memory is physical, an interior alpha estimate should survive coarsening and independent physical providers.
Synthetic controls should recover implementation behavior while remaining ineligible for physical cross-source closure.
